job.job_title: Agentic AI & GenAI Test Automation Engineer
job.job_description:
Position: Agentic AI & GenAI Test Automation Engineer
Experience: 7+ Years
Location: Pan India
Joining: Immediate or within 15 days




Key Responsibilities

Test Automation

Design, develop, and maintain robust automation frameworks for UI, API, and integration testing.
Create and execute automated regression, smoke, functional, and end-to-end test suites.
Develop reusable test components to improve execution efficiency and maintainability.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

Agentic AI & GenAI Validation

Validate agent-to-agent interactions, workflow orchestration, and AI-driven decision-making processes.
Test LLM-powered workflows, retrieval mechanisms, prompt execution, and tool invocation scenarios.
Design test strategies to evaluate AI output consistency, accuracy, reliability, and guardrails.
Validate AI observability, traceability, and audit requirements.

Healthcare Product Quality Assurance

Ensure compliance with healthcare quality standards and data privacy requirements.
Validate patient-facing and operational workflows across healthcare applications.
Perform test data management while maintaining confidentiality and regulatory compliance.

API & Integration Testing

Design and automate API test suites using REST/GraphQL services.
Perform contract, integration, and end-to-end testing.

Quality Engineering

Participate in requirement analysis and provide feedback from a quality perspective.
Perform risk-based testing and quality assessments.
Analyze defects, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with developers for resolutions.
Generate quality metrics, reports, and release readiness assessments.

Required Skills

Technical Skills

Strong experience in test automation using JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java.
Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as:

Selenium
Playwright (preferred)
Experience in API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, and Jenkins.
Experience with Git and version control practices.
Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Experience using JIRA to create bugs, test plans, and test suites.
Experience using Confluence for documentation.

AI/GenAI Testing Knowledge

Understanding of:

Generative AI
Agentic AI systems
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Multi-Agent Workflows
Exposure to testing AI-driven applications, conversational systems, or intelligent assistants.
Knowledge of prompt testing and evaluation methodologies.

Healthcare Domain

Experience in healthcare, payer, provider, clinical, or digital health platforms.
Understanding of healthcare regulations, data privacy, and compliance considerations is an added advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Playwright for modern web automation.
Experience validating AI agents built using LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Familiarity with observability and monitoring solutions.
Exposure to accessibility and security testing.

Desired Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
Ability to work in cross-functional Agile teams.
Continuous improvement mindset and passion for automation.
Ability to adapt quickly in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
